sequential_dependency.intermediate: Selected key color and 4-coordinate bounding box of the noncorner key-colored footprint.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Read the unique colored corner, collect all other cells with that color, and compute their exact input-dependent bounding box.

sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Changing the key-selected bounding box changes which context pixels are in the cropped output and its dimensions. B cannot determine the crop until A chooses the key-color footprint and derives its bounds.
